records.question: What are the common side effects of Extor?
records.answer: Common side effects mein dizziness, headache, tiredness aur ankle/feet swelling ho sakti hai. Agar symptom severe ho ya persist kare to doctor se rabta karein.

records.question: I feel dizzy after taking the tablet. What should I do?
records.answer: Baith ya let jayein, achanak kharay na hon, aur BP check kar saken to karein. Behoshi, chest pain ya severe weakness ho to urgent medical help lein.

records.question: Roman Urdu: My ankles are swelling after Extor.
records.answer: Ankle swelling amlodipine se ho sakti hai. Diuretic khud se start na karein; doctor ko treatment review karna chahiye.

records.question: Mixed: I have a headache after taking Extor.
records.answer: Mild headache ho to rest aur hydration madad kar sakte hain. Severe, persistent headache ya neurological symptoms hon to medical advice lein.

records.question: Extor ke baad nausea ho raha hai.
records.answer: Nausea mild ho to hydration rakhein; agar vomiting zyada ho, dehydration ho ya symptom persist kare to doctor/pharmacist se contact karein.

records.question: My heartbeat feels fast after the tablet.
records.answer: Fast ya irregular heartbeat ko ignore na karein. Agar chest pain, breathlessness, fainting ya severe palpitations hon to urgent medical care lein.

records.question: Roman Urdu: I feel very weak after taking Extor.
records.answer: Weakness ke saath BP low ho sakta hai; baith jayein aur BP check karein. Severe weakness, fainting ya confusion ho to urgent help lein.

records.question: Mixed: My lips are swelling and I am having trouble breathing.
records.answer: Ye emergency ho sakti hai. Foran emergency medical help lein aur medicine ki next dose clinician ke advice ke baghair na lein.

records.question: Can I take another medicine for the dizziness?
records.answer: Dizziness ke liye koi nayi medicine khud se start na karein; pehle BP check karein aur doctor/pharmacist se confirm karein kyun ke interactions ho sakte hain.
